title: HostInfo
description: Identity and environment of the .NET host process. Returned by the host.ping JSON-RPC method so the renderer can confirm it was built from the same contract generation as the host.

contractVersion.description: Version of the /schema set the host was built against. The renderer compares this with its own generated CONTRACT_VERSION and fails loudly on mismatch.

appVersion.description: Informational version of the DiffHacker host assembly.

platform.description: Operating system family the host is running on.

osDescription.description: Human-readable OS description, as reported by the runtime.

processArchitecture.description: Process architecture, for example x64 or arm64.

startedAtUtc.description: UTC instant at which the host process started.
